source: Have a break, have a KitKat
raw:
{
  "literal": "خذ استراحة، تناول كيت كات",
  "adaptation": "خدلك بريك، خدلك كيت كات",
  "back_translation": "Take a break, have a KitKat",
  "approach": "adapted",
  "notes": "I used the casual Egyptian vernacular 'خدلك' (have/take) and retained the English loanword 'بريك' (break), which is universally used in Egyptian colloquial Arabic, completely avoiding the stiff and unnatural tone of formal Arabic."
